## Description

Patient 360 becomes one page: banner (name, age, date of birth, MRN, blood group, language, life-stage label, allergy chip, alerts, care team, consent); vitals strip of six tiles with a trend line and a flag; problems with ICD-10 codes; medicines with "Add medicine" (MDV-P2-039); the life-stage module; results and trends table; history; timeline; and a right column for care gaps, goals (MDV-P2-038) and documents. Section buttons show everything or one part. Empty, loading, error and no-access states as today.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Every block shows its data source as today (provenance tags) and an empty state when there is nothing.
- [ ] **AC2.** The section buttons filter the page and are keyboard operable; the choice is kept per user in the session only.
- [ ] **AC3.** The page works at 375 px (one column), 200 % zoom and right to left in Arabic; axe has no violations.
- [ ] **AC4.** A user without clinical access sees the banner and the locked notice only (server decides, as today).

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
